challenge.better_approach: Looked: moving the md files whole into requirements/ is cheaper but keeps their history and quotes, against 0.2.2 (fold in the meanings, jettison the history). Most of their content already sits in the outline, so distillation is mostly deletion.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That no code parses the md files' content beyond core-values.md (test_core_values) and the I-*.md glob in inspector unbuilt_intentions / compiler gather_sources; the glob readers stay working on an empty set until 2b.
challenge.prior_art: Measured: outline already holds lazy-init (5.3.4.1), troubles (3.4.3.x), addressing and links (4.x), domains (11.4), ticket parts (3.3.2), orient (17.15). Only the roots, the artifact tense rule, the seed test, prebuild migration, approved-proofs/unvouched-green and the CLAUDE.md line are missing.
challenge.real_collision: I-the-cairn-device says the cairn device owns the trouble list; outline 6.3.4 puts troubles in Recovery. The outline is newer and is the source of truth, so that line is not carried. CLAUDE.md points at telos.md and core-values.md; it is rewritten in ticket 4 but its pointers are repointed here so nothing dangles.

answers.falsifier: Done: the pieces still pass the outline-folder proof, 19-the-roots.md carries the six CP narratives and whys the code pins, no md intention remains in the commons folder, and no live reader names one. Wrong intent: a distilled line loses a meaning Akien finds missing.
answers.from_idea: none, because the decision was made in conversation and recorded at /home/akien/.claude/projects/-home-akien-dev-src-cairn/memory/outline-pieces-replace-charters.md
answers.how: Distill each md to intention + why; add only the lines the outline lacks (19-the-roots.md plus entries in 00, 03, 09, 10, 17); add 19 to TOC.md; repoint test_core_values and test_quorum, docstrings, MAP.md and the open tickets owned by an md; git rm the mds; the folder's JSON machinery (host-seams, charter, validations) is ticket 2b.
answers.traces_to: Law 1 (one settled statement of each intention, read not re-derived) and Law 5 (the address carries what a mind needs now).
answers.what: The homeless intentions in CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/*.md fold into the schematic: telos, core values, Rule 1 and the system-wide aims become 19-the-roots.md, the rest become entries in the sections they belong to, the md files are deleted, and their readers point at requirements/.

bullets.text: Second of four: most homeless intentions were already restated in the outline; the fold is mostly deletion plus one roots piece.
Eight open tickets name an md as owning_intention; clearance json-parses the owner, so they were already unclearable; they repoint to the cairn device charter.
